channel.title: Livable Telluride — Family & Kids
channel.description: Upcoming storytime, youth programs, and all-ages activities across the Telluride region.

item.title: [Sun, Jun 7] Parenting Book Club: How to Talk So Little Kids Will Listen
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Telluride Room 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM · Parenting Book Club discussing How to Talk So Little Kids Will Listen: A Survival Guide to Life With Children Ages 2-7 b Joanna Faber and Julie King. Participants will dive into respectful and effective solutions to the challenges of raising children. This program is being offered in collaboration with Bright Futures and Parents As Teachers. The first 10 registrants will receive a copy of the book to keep. Reach out to madiea@brightfuturesforchildren.org with questions. Child care and snacks will be provided. Club de lectura sobre crianza que abordará el libro *How to Talk So Little Kids Will Listen: A Survival Guide to Life With Children Ages 2-7*, de Joanna Faber y Julie King. Los participantes explorarán soluciones respetuosas y eficaces para los desafíos que conlleva la crianza de los hijos. Este programa se ofrece en colaboración con Bright Futures y Parents As Teachers. …

item.title: [Sun, Jun 7] Drop In Ping Pong
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Lower Terrace - outdoors 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM · Drop by the library for casual table tennis matches. Our ping pong table will be set up and ready for players of all ages and skill levels. Whether you're a first-timer or a seasoned player, come enjoy this classic game with family and friends. No registration needed - just drop in! First come, first served (pun intended!) Pase por la biblioteca para partidos casuales de tenis de mesa. Nuestra mesa de ping pong estará instalada y lista para jugadores de todas las edades y niveles de habilidad. Ya sea que juegue por primera vez o sea un jugador experimentado, venga a disfrutar de este juego clásico con familia y amigos. No necesita registrarse - ¡simplemente venga!

item.title: [Mon, Jun 8] Birding with Katie
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Patagonia Telluride, TELLURIDE Join local birder Katie Triest for an intro discussion about the birds of Telluride at the Telluride Patagonia store on June 8th from 5-6 and for a bird walk with Katie leaving from the Telluride Patagonia store on June 9th at 8:30 am. Folks can sign up for the bird walk on Patagonia's Instagram or come on into the Patagonia store. The talk and walk are free and open to all ages.
